subject: Use bool for return types in hashtable functions (#2432)
reason: The change is a pure refactor: hashtable/kvstore functions that already returned exactly 0 or 1 now return C99 bool (false/true, which compare equal to 0/1), plus comment updates and de-nesting rewrites with identical control flow. The one deleted function, kvstoreHashtableAddOrFind, has no remaining callers in the tree, and no call site does arithmetic on or non-boolean comparison of the changed return values. No command reply, data structure, replication or persistence behavior changes, so a compared sequence or fault scenario would have nothing to detect.
